pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygons with jagged edge angularity. Darker center pixels transition to lighter tawny perimeters with semi-smooth gradients. Spatial area is highly variable with deep indentations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Broad, continuous light-cream pathways with clear multi-path junction nodes. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, typically widening at intersections and narrowing adjacent to acute patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D contour along the upper neck mane, presenting as a short, bristled silhouette against the out-of-focus foliage background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct, raised, circular nodule with textural disruption and de-pigmented greyish tone is visible on the upper flank near the dorsal ridge transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent raised cutaneous mass or nodule is located on the right upper flank/shoulder region, contrasting with the local pelage texture.
